_comment: One object per recompile. repo = GitHub owner/name. asset = regex over release asset names (default: first .nro or .zip). install_dir = where a bare .nro or a non-rooted zip goes (default /switch/<name>). icon = direct png link (optional). Game assets stay the user's job.

packages.name: example-port
packages.title: Example Port
packages.description: PC port recompiled for Switch. Copy the game files next to the .nro.
